$comment: These are brotli byte budgets for the built package. The tolerance is a fraction of the budget.
The command `npm run size` prints the sizes. The command `npm run size -- --check` fails when a size is over its budget plus the tolerance.
Raise a budget in the pull request that grows the bundle. The command `npm run size -- --update` writes the current sizes.
The entry without imports measures a bare import of the package. `typeOnlyPeers` fails the check when a bundle imports a peer dependency at runtime.
